text:
taylor: Proposal: introduce a richer route header to carry metadata + sampling hint. thinking name: `X-Rd-RouteMeta` so it doesn't collide with tenant keys. will open an RFC PR.
neha: concrete question: does this change how quota is computed? we need clarity for billing.
taylor: good call. quota stays per-request (no change). the route meta is purely for telemetry + routing heuristics. admins can opt-in to expanded telemetry.
owen: how will SDKs handle this? current clients send a simple string route token. adding JSON will be a breaking wire change if servers expect structured payload.
leigh: plan for graceful compatibility: server accepts both token-string and JSON blob. SDKs should default to token for hot paths. provide an explicit API to send expanded JSON (e.g., `client.set_route_meta({...})`).
taylor: server-side constraints: limit expanded header to 4096 bytes, drop extra attributes if over limit and emit a `route.meta.truncated` metric. invalid JSON -> 400.
neha: telemetry naming suggestion: keep metrics stable. emit `route.requests.total` always; emit `route.requests.sampled` when sample flag present; also `route.meta.truncated` and `route.meta.size_bytes` histogram.
owen: perf concern: JSON per-request increases header overhead. suggestion: support a compact route id token for high-TP flows (resolve to metadata server-side). SDKs should let users send either `route_token` or `route_meta_json`.
leigh: agree. add an opt-in console checkbox to expand tokens into JSON for customers who want attribute-level telemetry. default = token.
taylor: SDK changes (py/ts/go): add `enable_route_meta` config (false by default). When true, send JSON header like: `X-Rd-RouteMeta: {"route_id":"search.v3.query","sample":true,"attrs":{"env":"prod","team":"payments"}}`.
neha: also add short telemetry ping (opt-in) so we can measure adoption: event `route_meta.mode` = `token|json`. keep values minimal to avoid PII.
owen: delivery plan? we need server acceptance before SDKs cut releases. otherwise SDKs reporting warnings will frustrate users.
taylor: timeline suggestion: week A - server accepts both wire formats behind FF; week B - SDKs add compat flag and logging; week C - console tile reads sampled counts and displays sampled ratio; week D - decide default for new tenants and announce deprecation of legacy header in 2 months.
leigh: SDK UX ask: surface a local deprecation warning via CLI `rwctl route-meta status` and a short migration helper code snippet in changelogs.
neha: SRE ops: rate-limit expanded metadata requests per tenant to avoid ingestion storms. maybe 100 req/s for expanded meta by default and a throttled fallback for metadata-only samples.
taylor: will add throttling + a server-side metric `route.meta.rejected_rate_limit`. also add a header validation step in the ELB layer to avoid big payloads.
ci-bot: CI queued: server/routemeta-accept-both PR by taylor  build: started
owen: we'll need e2e tests: python client sends token; TS client sends JSON with `enable_route_meta=true`; ensure both accepted and metrics emitted. I'll draft tests.
leigh: note for product: the console feature should show the sampling ratio and a small "metadata enabled" flag per route to avoid confusion. product PMs will scope this.
taylor: curl example to test now:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "X-Rd-RouteMeta: {\"route_id\":\"search.v3.query\",\"sample\":true}" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete

neha: could we allow a short encoded form (base64 compact JSON) to minimize header length while retaining structured semantics? server would accept base64 or plain JSON.
owen: that helps. SDKs can expose `route_meta_encode: 'none'|'base64'| 'token'`. default = token.
leigh: final ask: add a small experimental feature flag for a subset of customers so we can monitor ingestion before wider rollout.
taylor: agreed. I'll include FF id in RFC. thanks all. :thumbsup:
